verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt returns HTTP 200 on developer.konghq.com, the domain that hosts Insomnia's docs. Those docs are also served as markdown (.md) URLs such as /insomnia/test.md and /insomnia/mcp-clients-in-insomnia.md, which an agent can ingest directly. The llms.txt is Kong-wide, though, and the probe excerpt does not confirm it indexes Insomnia pages. missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt lists Insomnia docs, an Insomnia-specific llms.txt or agent-docs guide, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
